name: late-night-hallway-selfie
image_purpose: hallway lighting, outfit, and candid selfie reference

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic late-night hallway selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with loose slightly frizzy brunette hair, wearing an opaque black long-sleeve top, modest knee-length black skirt or fitted trousers, and black boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing close to a worn apartment hallway wall, phone held for a quick one-shot selfie, one leg slightly bent, cold overhead lights, quiet empty corridor, natural unposed posture, no braless or exposed styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold overhead hallway light, slightly underexposed grainy iPhone-night look, quiet solitary but safe atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, portrait 9:16, natural perspective, slight grain, realistic wall texture, no cinematic bokeh.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with loose slightly frizzy brunette hair takes a quick late-night hallway selfie, wearing an opaque black long-sleeve top, modest knee-length skirt or fitted trousers, and black boots. Use worn hallway walls, cold overhead lights, slight underexposure, natural one-shot framing, and realistic phone grain. No exposed midriff or underwear.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, braless styling, mini skirt, exposed midriff, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted anatomy, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
